Messages.Body:
Hello,

Can an anarch use Piper and pay 1 lees pool for recruiting an ally ?

Charisma
Cardtype: Master
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire's recruit ally actions
cost 1 less blood or pool (but never less than 0 blood or pool).
Artist: Talon Dunning

Piper
Cardtype: Master
Master. Requires a ready anarch.
A ready untapped anarch you control employs or recruits a retainer or
ally from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is
not an action and cannot be blocked. Tap that anarch.
Artist: Andrew Trabbold

Sorry if it was already answered but I couldn't find it...

Nicolas.

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:


I was thinking about this combo a few times over the last few months,
but decided it'd be 'no' so didn't bother asking, because of the whole
action/not action thing.

Similarly, Charisma on Antonio D'Erlette doesn't work with his ability.

The reason I started thinking about it though was because of the below
from the 7/7/7 RTR:

"All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played ("as
normal" or otherwise). "

We also had a discussion recently (don't have the link) on equipping
vs playing (ala Concealed Weapon), how DI interacts with it, etc.
Piper is a desirable card simply for the fact that your recruiting
can't be blocked. No stealth required and they can Sudden the Piper,
but can't cancel your War Ghoul or whatever. Pack Alpha is another
example of a retaining that is not an action.

Brandon
